name: Sunset Rings
description: Rings stack concentrically in a mixed ink palette, alternating direction row by row, like a target seen through haze.

code.style: --rule: ( overflow: hidden; position: relative; visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } /* Four stacks of 50 rings, generated once on the host: the colors cycle with the ring and reverse on even rows, and the stack's anchor alternates from cell to cell. Written per cell, the same 50 layers were copied into every one. */ :after { content: ''; position: absolute; @size: 900% 1022%; background: @var(--rings-a); } @match(i % 2 == 0) { :after { background: @var(--rings-b); } } @row(even) { :after { background: @var(--rings-c); } } @match(i % 2 == 0 && y % 2 == 0) { :after { background: @var(--rings-d); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; box-sizing:border-box; --rings-a: @m(50, ( radial-gradient( ellipse 100% 40%, @pn(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 50%, transparent 0% ) 100% 50% / calc(@n() * 2%) calc(@n() * 2%) no-repeat )); --rings-b: @m(50, ( radial-gradient( ellipse 100% 40%, @pn(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 50%, transparent 0% ) 0 50% / calc(@n() * 2%) calc(@n() * 2%) no-repeat )); --rings-c: @m(50, ( radial-gradient( ellipse 100% 40%, @pn(var(--color4), var(--color3), var(--color2), var(--color1)) 50%, transparent 0 ) 100% 50% / calc(@n() * 2%) calc(@n() * 2%) no-repeat )); --rings-d: @m(50, ( radial-gradient( ellipse 100% 40%, @pn(var(--color4), var(--color3), var(--color2), var(--color1)) 50%, transparent 0 ) 0 50% / calc(@n() * 2%) calc(@n() * 2%) no-repeat )); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
